name: Mhondoro-Possessed Creature (CR +1)
body:
Lingering spirits of past kings, chiefs, and other great figures, mhondoro (also svikiro) inhabit maneless lions and lie in wait until they sense a host in need of their aid. When they sense such a creature, the mhondoro asks if that creature is willing to accept its aid, though it does not specify what form this aid will take. If the creature agrees, the mhondoro possesses it and aids the creature in its quest. How long a mhondoro inhabits its host varies based on the length and urgency of the host’s task. While most mhondoro are benevolent and attempt to honor the need of the creature they assist, some attempt to assert their will over the host. Even the most benevolent mhondoro exerts considerable influence over how the creature performs its quest—the “price” for its assistance.

Creating a Mhondoro-Possessed Creature

“Mhondoro-Possessed” is an acquired template that can be added to any humanoid creature. A mhondoro-possessed creature retains all of its statistics and special abilities except as noted here:

Challenge Rating: Same as base creature +1.
Senses: The host gains darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If it already has darkvision, the range increases by 60 feet.
Special Defenses: The host gains negative energy resistance 10 and regeneration 5 (electricity, force, or sonic). The host also gains the mhondoro’s ancestral vigor special quality, which gives a +2 insight bonus on saving throws.
Skills: The host may use the mhondoro’s skill bonuses in place of its own for Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skills, if the mhondoro’s are higher.
Languages: The host can speak, read, and write any of the languages the mhondoro knows.
